articles.title: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative
articles.snippet: Initial testing will focus on moving digital commercial deposits across participating institutions before linking to broader digital asset ecosystems.

articles.title: Animoca Brands delays IPO plans, suspends merger talks with Currenc
articles.snippet: Talks between the two kicked off late last year, with plans for the former to own 95% of the merged company.

articles.title: Elon Musk's X brings crypto and stock trading via Coinbase, Kraken and Interactive Brokers partnership
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s X lets U.S. users tap cashtags such as $BTC to view live charts and access Coinbase, Kraken and other trading platforms.

articles.title: Bitcoin could test $90,000 after shorts get squeezed, but traders warn leverage is building
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has broken out to $86,000, but analysts say the next leg depends on whether spot buyers continue to show up as leverage builds.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.
